description: Start a batch auto-label run on an Open Label project. Runs are dry-run by default (preview counts, no writes); set dryRun=false to materialize predictions as editable pre-labels — never annotations. Sources: LLM (default, ontology-driven), ENDPOINT (a configured ML backend), OCR (document text extraction), DETECTION (open-vocabulary boxes from label→prompt mappings via the concept service). Requires open-label:write scope.

detectionPrompts.description: DETECTION source: label→prompt mappings (prompt defaults to the label; labels must exist on the RectangleLabels control).

dryRun.description: Default true. Set false to write predictions for real.

endpointId.description: Model endpoint id (required for source ENDPOINT).

maxTasks.description: Cap the number of tasks in this run.

model.description: Model name override for the LLM source.

name: open_label_create_auto_label_run
